card.name: The word preparations after a drug name
card.fires_on: The word "preparation" or "preparations" right after a drug or substance name, such as digitalis, thyroid, insulin-containing or botulinum toxin.

modes.label: Drug class + preparations
modes.description: "preparations" follows a drug name when naming a product class in an interaction or contraindication.

modes.label: Lab or product sense
modes.description: "preparation" refers to a lab sample or a specific product formulation.
modes.example: as measured in human liver microsomal<< preparations>>, in vitro.
